explore.goal: Explore conservatively, avoid collisions reliably, and make steady coverage progress
constraints: The robot executes controllable motion as open-loop pulses
The supervisor controls one robot locally.
Do not collide with obstacles or other robots.
Every non-terminal explore state must enable exactly one controllable action.
If obstacle_front occurs, transition to a dedicated recovery state whose only controllable is move_backward, rotate_clockwise, rotate_counterclockwise, or full_rotate.
States reached by obstacle_left must enable exactly one controllable and it must be rotate_clockwise or full_rotate.
States reached by obstacle_right must enable exactly one controllable and it must be rotate_counterclockwise or full_rotate.
No state reached by any obstacle event may enable move_forward or random_walk.
After any obstacle event, the supervisor must pass through an obstacle-recovery state before returning to exploration.
Do not use full_rotate in initial, clear, search, or path_clear-reached states; it is allowed only in dedicated obstacle-recovery states.
